messages:
maya: ran an int4 bring-up for helio7b-hybridproj on the quant runner — saw a noticeable perplexity + rouge drop on the summarization suite, attaching quick logs
raf: can you paste the exact command you ran? was this with rotary_freq_scale=1.0 or did you change the rotary mode?
maya: here is the command i used:
```
./run_eval.sh --model helio7b-hybridproj --quant int4 --batch 1 --rotary-scale 0.8 --rotary-mode=headwise --vocab-map=auto --suite=summarization
```
eli: interesting — on my baseline run with `rotary-scale=1.0` perf looked stable. did you flip tokenizer normalization? quick check: `tokenizer.normalizer=True`? :thinking:
maya: tokenizer normalization was enabled (NFKC). i tried toggling it; small diffs but the big regression lines up with enabling `proj_order: hybrid` (hybrid projection ordering) which we recently added for this model. suspect proj order interacting with headwise rotary scaling.
harper: can you share the minimal config diff? possible kvcache index mapping off-by-one when projection order changes — we've seen similar migrating llama->mistral conversions :eyes:
maya: minimal config diff below:
```
rotary:
  mode: headwise
  freq_scale: 0.8
proj_order: hybrid
vocab_map: roundtrip
```
raf: try swapping to `--rotary-mode=perhead --rotary-scale=1.0` and re-run the suite. if metrics recover then it's probably rotary scaling/handshake mismatch rather than quantization noise.
triage-bot: regression detector: summarization suite degraded. rouge-L delta: -7.4 vs baseline. tags: [int4, rotary-scale, vocab-handoff] :warning:
eli: i can run a bisect across quantization blocks tomorrow (int8->int4) to isolate when the delta appears. also try `--vocab-map=identity` to rule out token shadowing.
sam: fyi we previously saw token-shadowing where normalization collapsed two CJK variants to same id -> kvcache collisions and repeat tokens. quick mitigation i used was adding a small sentinel offset in tokenizer for ambiguous codepoints to preserve uniqueness.
maya: thanks — i'll try perhead + identity vocab_map and post numbers. if noise persists i'll upload a minimal repro and link the bench job id (7865). :thumbsup:
harper: if you get a small repro, can we add a CI smoke job for `rotary-scale=0.8` + int4 and set a regression alert threshold (rouge-L drop > 5)? that would catch future regressions faster.
maya: on it — uploading payload now and kicking off run 7865. will post link when done.
